scope: Narrow cash, treasury retention, share-compensation and dilution review. Does not revalidate all issuer sources or business forecasts.
economic_checks: Historical other income removed from core operating EBIT before separate treasury yield is added
Own-treasury return is included once annually and accumulates only in undistributed cash
Terminal operating value uses funded operating cash and excludes treasury interest
Terminal equity includes retained cash once
NEWGEN begins with full reported diluted claims and future annual dilution without an additional SBC cash charge
Historical negative NEWGEN SBC credit is subtracted in the core-cash normalization rather than treated as continuing income
NUCLEUS includes employee trust holdings in full paid-up share count and funds future award purchases in cash, with zero added dilution
All modeled cash lease principal and interest is subtracted after D&A addback. Opening lease liabilities are not also deducted
Positive/negative working-capital changes and operating liquidity buffers are explicitly funded
remaining_limits: NUCLEUS broad INR942.1cr issuer treasury metric is not a verified unrestricted liquidation floor

NUCLEUS customer prepayments produce negative working capital. Their continuing availability is an operating assumption, with modeled transition losses, not proof that all gross cash is immediately distributable
NEWGEN future dilution and NUCLEUS cash award budgets are scenario assumptions. Changes in compensation design require model revision
Forecast operating tax may conservatively omit tax deductions associated with equity or cash share compensation. This review found no material optimistic tax treatment from that choice
No independent probability or business-moat validation performed
conclusion: No material arithmetic or cash/treasury/SBC double-counting issue found in the reviewed versions. The uncertainty is predominantly economic and source composition, not mechanical retention accounting.
